name: ROAD_CLOSED_WHITE_LONG_SKINNY
notes: Department of Logistics and Infrastructure (DIPL) civil standard drawing, CAD sheet in colour; every dimension from the sheet unless stated; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet CS3505 'Road closure sign' (2017): folding two-half sign (permanently attached top half, folding bottom half), background white Class 1; the sign face is drawn 'not to scale' with the border 25 and edge 25 and its size from the elevation (300 + 1800 post spacing + 300 = 2400 wide, 100/200/200/100 = 600 high; the face is drawn 4:1). Legend not specified: black ROAD over CLOSED, letters measured 160 high with cap tops 90 / 340 (rows 90/160/90/160/100), Series E by the drawn widths (ROAD 612, CLOSED 900 measured; E 634 / 914). Not the AS 1743 T2-4 / G9-20 ROAD CLOSED (one line, 1800 x 300).
